translation.name: Urim-Kalpm
translation.englishName: Urim: Wurkapm a Maur Wailen Portions

content: Jisas wreitn ha kirkhap
Wang a arpm ekg yapm pa plaln pa, tu kin pa wreitn ak kang mningket paitn ai ye kweiur kweiur wepmij wor a tu numprampen pa ye kai tipmning teng pa akal ak nel yipmri a Jisas pa.
Pake tu ari weij a ak hmpri tipmning teng ek pa, pa apm wa talpul tukulein ase,
yatom tu kai kahor tipmning teng wonen pa ari, ake tu ari yipmri a Wailen Jisas pa.
Yatom tu atn akwonalmpen wailet atn pa, ari tu wutnan ekg ari melnum wekg ur a nowe hapm tungkoren muinmainet paitn ai paln atn yampingkenten.

Tu kin pa ari tolpa tu kark paitn, yatom nel homtmpok lam ikg alntuen pa kinar knokg tolti, ari melnum wekg pa la nasen la tolpa, “Ti wa kipm kul kor melnum a arpm mlepm ti kul wrik a uwen tu kmel a mo ti, ekg nte?
Ti kipm ri kil ake ha ti, kil apm wreitn ase. Ti kipm ikwonilmpen yangkipm a pike kil la nasepm hakaino Kalili pa la tolpa,
‘Warim Kpman a Melnum hi tu uk kai wam a tu melnum a ntekg paitnpaitn pa, yatom hi tu karkurntel kai yo kwatingki pa wiyel ye kai uwentel, om ak wang wraur pa kil hi wa wreitn.’ ”
Yatom wa tu kin akwonalmpen yangkipm a pike kil la pa,
yatom tu wa pleln atn wrik a tu uwen Jisas pa kai tolti, la kiti nasi tu melnum wampwam yikakwomwrij a Jisas pa, namponen tu wrongwailet pa, ekg kweiur kweiur wrongwailet a wet tu ari a paln pa.
Tu kin a kai la kiti yangkipm pa nasi tu melnum yangkipm kuinen a Jisas pa pati, Maria a ha wail Maktala, a Joana, a Maria, man a Jems pa, wa tu kin tiur ai namponenten.
Ari tu pa la tolpa, plpa tu la yangkipm akplain ur tolti. Tu ake ukpma ekla a tu la pa.

Ari Pita pa kil wreitn tolti, kil aktutu kai wrik a pike tu eln Jisas hele pa, yatom kil atn hen ti ikglangken ari, kil ari hapm kalpmel tolti ha. Yatom kil wa pleln kai tolti om wa kil akwonalmpen wailet ekg kweiur kweiur a wet paln ripa.
Melnum wekg ari Jisas ngko ya a kai Emeus
Ak wang pa, disaipel wekg ur a Jisas pa, tuwekg akal ekg kai ha ur a tu kwe tolpa Emeus, ha ur a ark watinet ketn, tol kilomita wampwam yikakwomwrij (11), ekg Jerusalem pa.
Yatom tuwekg kor la kiti hor ya pa kai ekg kweiur kweiur wrongwailet a pike paln ripa.
Tuwekg ekla wailet la kiti tolpa kai pa, Jisas kil alkil palnten ngkom ntien kai kompwrij tolpa kai.
Yatom kwei ur ak hmprien ikg, om tuwekg ake ari tolpa, kil pa Jisas.
Yatom Jisas roponten la tolpa, “Kipmekg la kiti kuina ur itna wampel kai?” Om tuwekg atning tolpa, tuwekg kai atn ya pa, yatom kil ari tolpa tuwekg pa ipma kalkut.
Yatom wrij ur a tuwekg pa tu kwe tolpa Kliopas. Pa kil akalmpe tolpa, “Ti kitn wrij hute ti kitn ake ari kweiur kweiur wailmanten a pike paln kai Jerusalem pa?”

Ari wa Jisas roponten la tolpa, “Kuina ai?” Ari wa tuwekg akalmpe la tolpa, “Mentekg wet la kiti Jisas a Nasaret pa. Kil melnum ek wripm a Maur Wailen akrkahan ukwel titnongket, yatom kil laron yangkipm namponen titnongket, wa ntekg kweiur kweiur titnongket weten, yatom tu wrong kinkpman ariel tolpa kil pa melnum wailen pake.
Tu melnum ipma krakgen a Maur Wailen a atn hep wa tu melnum wail wail amen ti uk kil kai wam a tu Rom ekg erel mo, yatom tu karkurntel kai yo kwatingki.
Ari men ti pike akwonalmpen tolpa kil pa melnum a tol kil ikirmpen mento Israel pake! Yatom kweiur kweiur a pike paln pa, apm tol wang wraur ase.
Yatom wet ti ak kang pa, wa men wreitn paitn ekg tu kin tiur alpmenen, tu wreitn ak kang mningket paitn ai kai kahor tipmning teng wonen a tu eln Jisas hele pa.
Ari tu kai ari yipmri akil pa ake ha. Yatom tu wa plelnten kul la naso la tolpa, tu ari maur akwapel wekg a Maur Wailen pa, yatom tuwekg la nasen la tolpa, kil apm wreitn arpm mlepm ase.
Yatom wa tu tiur alpmenen pa wa pike nel kai wrik a tu elntel hele pa ari apm tol a tu kin pa la kiti pake: ake tu ariel.”
Yatom Jisas la nasen la tolpa, “Ti kipmekg ti hmit, ake wa kipmekg akwonalmpen yangkipm wrongwailet a pike tu melnum ek wripm a Maur Wailen la pa!
Ti kipmekg ti ake ari tolpa melnum a Maur Wailen kwa nar ekg akwi tu wrong kinkpman pa, kil wi wleket wail ripa plaln pa, kil kai arpm namponen Maur Wailen, wi titnongket klalen wail pa?”
Yatom Jisas laron yangkipm yiprokgen wrongwailet a la kiti kil ti nasen katen kai Moses ai, wa kulngkul tu melnum ek wripm a Maur Wailen a tu ro hel kai wurkapm a Maur Wailen pa.
Tunten kul yampingken ha a tuwekg akal arpme pa, yatom Jisas pa akplainel ipma a tuwekg pa akal kai ekg haren kai om,
ari wa tuwekg pa lokel la tolpa, “Ti mning krehet ekg al mning tike, ti kitn kul ntio hokgi tipen.” Yatom kil kahor akal ntien arpm.
Tunten arpm akal al ekpma pa, kil wi nak tingklak pa ukwor Maur Wailen plaln pa, kil kpor ukwen.
Kil ntekg tolpa yatom, ikg a tuwekg pa apm nungkwat ariel, ari kil apm wa kai hamten ase.
Yatom tuwekg nasi tita la tolpa, “Aklahle! Ti wet kil la kiti naso yiprokgen a hel kai Wurkapm a Maur Wailen pa ngko ya pa, pa wet ak ntekg ipma a mentekg ti utopen paitn.”
Yatom ak wang ketn pa tuwekg wreitn tolti, pleln kai Jerusalem ari tu melnum yangkipm kuinen wampwam yikakwomwrij a Jisas nti tu tiur pa kor tita ark.
Ari tu hmprak la kiti nasen kuina ur a wet paln ekg Saimon pa, pa la tolpa, “Wailen apm wreitn aklahle ase! Ti kil wet paln kai Saimon, kil ariel pa.”

Tu la tolpa nasen plaln pa, tuwekg ti wa la nasen la tolpa, Jisas palnten ngko ya pa, yatom tunten ngkom hor ya pa kai pa tuwekg ake ari tolpa kil Jisas pa, om tunten kai paln arpm kai wan pa. Kil kpor nak tingklak pa ukwen plaln pa, om tuwekg ari tolpa Jisas apm pake.
Jisas kil paln ekg tu disaipel alkilen
Tu disaipel a Jisas tu la kiti la tolpa atn pa, Wailen pa palnten aktutu tolti la nasen la tolpa, “Ipma akipm pa irk mehen!”
Ari tu akwonalmpen tolpa tu ari maur a kmel ur yatom tu kark paitn wrijen tolti.
Ari wa kil la nasen la tolpa, “Ti wa kipm wreitn paitn akwonalmpen wailet ekg nte?

Ti kipm ri nepm wam akupm ti! Wa kipm ari tolpa, pa apm kupm apm tike. Ti kipm kul ri wampirpme ik wampla ik itningke numpwam akupm ti! Lak maur pa, tol ake kipm ari palk a knal tol a kipm ari kupm ti.”
Kil la tolpa plaln pa, kil planten nepm wam akil pa.
Yatom tu utopen, pake nikgwalpm a tu pa ark nowe nare, ake kai wrij. Om kil roponten la tolpa, “Kipm ye ekpma ur aki?”
Yatom tu ukwel yul tiel a wet tu aliln pa,
om tu ari a kil wi al.

Kil al yul pa plaln pa, kil la nasen la tolpa, “Kipm ari pa, pike kupm ntiepm arpm pa, kupm la nasepm yangkipmek wrongwailet a hel kai wurkapm a Moses a tu melnum ek wripm a Maur Wailen ro pa, wa hel kai wurkapm a Nangnang pa, a ak la kupm ti pa, pa apm paln ek arke ase, ti apm paln apm tike.”
Yatom kil ntekg nikgwalpm a tu pa paln wonrekele ari yangkipm wrongwailet a Maur Wailen pa.
Yatom kil la nasen la tolpa, “Tu ro la tolpa, melnum a Maur Wailen kwa nar ekg akwi tu wrong kinkpman pa, hi kil mo, om ak wang wraur pa, kil apm wa wreitn arpm.
Hi wa tu laron nang akil pa nasi tu wrong kinkpman pa, hi tu pleln ipma, yatom hi kil kwan paitnpaitn atu. Hi tu katen kwap ripa ak atn Jerusalem ti, yatom ye kai knokg wrongwailet ai.
Kipm alkipm ti pike nungkulkg a ikg ekg kweiur kweiur wrongwailet a paln pa, ti hi apm kipm alkipm ti laron nasi tu wrong kinkpman tike.

Ti kipm itning, hi kupm kwa Maur Wor nar ekg kipm a pike Yan alkupmen kil yipon yangkipm pa. Ti hi kipm irk nungkwangen irk ha wail ti irk kai ngko wang a hi kipm wi titnongket wail a Maur Wailen pa.”
Maur Wailen wi Jisas ye kaino ktnong
Yatom Jisas wi tu disaipel alkilen pa nel kai kinar ngko yampingken ha Petani pa, yatom kil kat wam pa, wa kil ropon Maur Wailen ekg al kil aklinjen.
Kil ropon Maur Wailen tolpa atn pa, kil nuhurnten tolti, Maur Wailen wiyel tolpa ye kai kaino ha wor alkilen ase.
Tu kpor klko lein kat nang akil plaln pa, tu pleln kaino kahor Jerusalem pa namponen utopen wailmanten.
Yatom tu ark wan yalming a Maur Wailen pa kat nang akil pa ukwel wor aklei wang tolti ark.
